title: The Radnor
description:
Enjoy the best of Nashville from this centrally located condo. Ideally situated between the airport and downtown, you’ll be just minutes from shopping, dining, and popular attractions—including the Grand Ole Opry. We are less than 5 miles from downtown broadway.

The space
Our home sits on a peaceful half-acre lot with a partially fenced yard. The condo is on the top floor of our residence with private entrance and completely separate from our living space. It offers about 1,000 square feet of space, complete with a cozy kitchenette and a portable stovetop for light cooking. You may also meet our friendly dog, Harlin, who loves to say hello in the backyard.

Guest access
Enjoy a private condo situated above our residence, offering its own exclusive entrance and complete separation from the main home for your privacy and comfort.

Other things to note
Looking for a unique Nashville experience? Reach out to us to arrange a private songwriter concert—bringing the Bluebird Café vibe straight to your living room or backyard with some of the worlds top talent.
